title: Wendell and the Postcard
author: P. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Noor Sandoval, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
